description:
The evidence behind a valuation, itemised: same-building comparable
    sales for the property, each with its registered price and date, its
    time adjustment on the published repeat-sales index (the district's own
    series, else the local authority's, else national) to the index's latest
    settled month with the carry receipt (`index_unavailable` and no
    adjustment where no series covers the property), any relisting penalty
    (pass `relisted_uprns` only to model an explicit -10% sensitivity for
    relisted/withdrawn comps; this is an assumption, not a measured discount), and the IQR fence that
    decided which comps count. Use it to show WHY a value is what it is;
    `valuation_full` gives the value itself. `lookback_months` 12–120.
    UK only. Costs 10 credits (10p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: comps_adjustments
title: Comparables with their time adjustments
